question: 2028 Summer Olympics will be hosted by which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Los Angeles.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2028 Summer Olympics** (officially the **Games of the 34th Olympiad,** also known as Los Angeles 2028 or LA28) is an upcoming international multi-sport event scheduled to take place from** July 14 to July 30, 2028, in and around Los Angeles, California, United States.**
 
• The 2024 Summer Olympics, officially the **Games of the 33rd Olympiad** and also known as Paris 2024, is an upcoming international multi-sport event that is scheduled to take **place from 26 July to 11 August 2024 with Paris** as its** main host city** and 16 cities spread across Metropolitan France and one in the French overseas **territory of Tahiti as subsites.**
 
• DOHA, - Qatar, is **determined **__to bring the** 2036 Summer Olympic** Games to Doha, according to a source familiar with the Olympic bidding process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Tokyo Olympics 2021 India Medals

 
• The opening ceremony for the Tokyo Olympics 2020, which was postponed because of pandemic fears, took place at the Tokyo National Stadium on July 23, 2021.
 
• 15 different countries' leaders were present at this function.
 
• Tokyo is the only Asian city to have twice hosted the Summer Olympics.
 
• The Japanese words Mirai, which means “Future,” and Towa, which means “Eternity,” are combined to form Miraitowa, the mascot for the Tokyo Olympics 2021.
